summary.text: Tiffany Williams-Rice is the Democratic candidate for the North Dakota House of Representatives, District 7, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An educator and healthcare professional, she says her focus is affordability, healthcare access, public education and workforce development.

paragraphs.text: Tiffany Williams-Rice earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Dakota in 2013, a graduate degree from Colorado State University in 2016 and a graduate degree from the University of Washington, Seattle in 2022.
Her career experience includes working as an educator.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described her background as spanning education, healthcare leadership, social services, compliance, accessibility initiatives and community-based programs.
Williams-Rice advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
She said rising housing, childcare and healthcare costs place financial pressure on working families, and that she wants practical solutions that improve affordability and workforce opportunities.
